open_gaps: Deterministically reconcile this repository against the numbered WEB-MUN/source register.
Acquire the full archive only through a permitted route if needed for the audited release.
Independently recompute the full-archive SHA-1 before treating the publisher-declared digest as byte verification.
Review participant consent, privacy/publicity, community validation and cultural-access constraints before any participant-derived audio or transcript promotion.
Keep commercial-use prohibition and ShareAlike/FreeSoftware conditions visible in downstream reuse decisions.
release_gate_effect: Does not pass the audited-release gate by itself; it narrows a dataset/audio gap without asserting consent or independent byte verification.
